subfiles.title: Airgram from USPOLAD Tokyo on Ben M. Page’s geological mission
subfiles.about: Transmits a Far East Command news release describing Stanford geologist Ben M. Page’s work to improve mineral exploration and identify industrial mineral reserves in Japan.
